guards: The METHOD transfers: exact occurrence binding, byte-exact surface verification, evidence-ladder review, ambiguity preservation, authority binding, and explicit routing may be reused; no linguistic conclusion transfers to another occurrence.

TP-LARGELEXICON-PVN-OCCURRENCE-META-BRIDGE-W1 is downstream and remains blocked until this packet has produced at least one EVIDENCE_READY_FOR_OWNER_CERTIFICATION bundle and the separately owner-authorized TP-LARGELEXICON-PVN-ACCEPTED-EDGE-OWNER-APPLICATION-W1 has emitted, hash-bound, and registered an accepted typed edge. This packet produces exactly zero accepted or certified edges and cannot unblock that bridge.
Select only the 95 records whose complete blocker set is missing_typed_graph_evidence in the regenerated first-2,000 A3 scan; fixtures and other blocker classes do not count.
Do not edit or relax tools/largelexicon_fact_bridge.py, its exact loc and surface checks, the accepted edge-status gate, its four authority families, or any source authority.

The crosswalk entry id is the page that displays the occurrence and is never lexical evidence; page context, root family, surface resemblance, normalization, lookup coverage, and candidate graph edges never establish lexeme, form, entry, or sense identity.
Use the existing qamus.graph_edge.v1 vocabulary and qamus.typed_claim_contract.v1 evidence modes; do not create a parallel edge, fact, certification, or evidence vocabulary.

Lexical identity requires cross-source corroboration from genuinely independent structured source facts at exact addresses. Repeated output from one engine or two views of one source is one source, not two.

Every candidate bundle preserves all rival entry and form candidates, contradiction and tension records, unresolved blockers, dependencies, guards, defeaters, and invalidation conditions. No first-row, highest-score, or page-local winner selection is allowed.

Every proposed lexeme_entry_edge or form_entry_edge remains candidate or ambiguous. This packet cannot emit certified or deterministic_exact status, call a certifier, write an accepted typed-graph bundle, or change certification state.

EVIDENCE_READY_FOR_OWNER_CERTIFICATION means only that a reconstructible candidate evidence bundle is ready for an independent owner/certifier lane. It is not an accepted edge and does not unblock the downstream meta bridge.

The run metadata must record SHA-256 values for qamus/indexes/largelexicon/target-schema/TARGET-RELEASE.json, qamus/examples/largelexicon-fact-bridge/real-data-scan.meta.json, qamus/indexes/quran-loc-surface/index.jsonl, qamus/lattice/lexeme-join-edges.jsonl, the packet-local out/largelexicon-typed-edge-evidence-wave1/upstream-typed-claims.jsonl, the evidence schema, the full evidence JSONL, and the committed sample plus metadata. A missing or stale hash ends SOURCE_GAP.

Start only from a clean isolated worktree. Freeze HEAD before edits under out/largelexicon-typed-edge-evidence-wave1/start-sha.txt, enforce tracked plus untracked changed paths from that SHA, run protected-input drift separately, and run git diff --check separately.
tools/check_regressions.py and docs/golden-commands.md are read-only in this packet. Their shared updates are reserved for the future single integration packet TP-PVN-REANCHOR-HARNESS-INTEGRATION-W1.

The full 95-row output is never committed. Committed samples and reports contain no source prose, external source labels, private reviewer artifacts, private paths, machine topology, credentials, public hover text, meaning, translation, or learner-visible material.
No existing A3 input, target-schema table, canonical graph, typed-graph bundle, fact ledger, projector registry, certification store, website payload, renderer, or live surface is writable.

non_deployment.statement: All outputs remain candidate evidence, abstentions, and review routes. This packet does not certify facts or edges, create learner-visible or public payloads, edit website code, deploy, or contact or mutate any live surface.

out_of_scope: Do not modify the integrated A3 bridge, target-schema migration, carried tables, canonical loc-surface index, lexeme lattice, existing typed-graph bundles, or authority digests.
Do not turn page context, root family, surface lookup, normalization, lemma recall, form recall, stem recall, or pattern recall into lexical identity.
Do not select among unresolved rivals or author a new entry, sense, meaning, contextual function, translation, public hover, or public colour claim.

Do not certify or emit accepted typed edges, invoke tools/certify_typed_fact.py, alter a fact ledger or certification store, unblock the downstream meta bridge, edit website payloads, or touch a live surface.
